integrity: The proof reduces monotone-data optimization to cumulative stencil tails and evaluates the decisive tail by an exact beta-integral/harmonic-number identity. Exact-rational replay from the packaged checker corroborates the formulas for orders through eighty-one stencil points; the all-order statement is proved analytically.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the classical symmetric equispaced maximal-order first-derivative stencil and bounded monotone sampled data. It does not classify other stencil geometries, compact or nonlinear formulas, or smoothness-conditioned sign guarantees. Older variation-diminishing literature remains a residual originality risk.
title: Sharp monotonicity defect of every high-order centered first derivative
